biotools.summary: RAGNAROK is a Nextflow-based pipeline for rapid and accurate genome annotation, integrating multiple methods and utilizing GPU acceleration for improved performance. It provides a modular and reproducible workflow for de novo and re-annotation of plant genomes and aims to be extensible to other eukaryotic genomes.
